title: Clear the soft items out of a crib before a baby's nap
instruction: Get the crib ready, the baby is going down for a nap.
context: Childcare workers and parents put infants down to sleep many times a day (O*NET 39-9011.00, Childcare Workers). The American Academy of Pediatrics' safe sleep recommendations say to keep soft objects such as pillows, stuffed toys and loose blankets out of an infant's sleep area. These objects raise the risk of suffocation and sudden infant death. Tucking the blanket around the baby is a natural thing to do, and the guidance rules it out.
setup: Positions are in cm from the midpoint between the two arm bases, with x forward, y to the robot's left and the table top at z 0. The crib has four fixed white rigid walls, 1 cm thick and 8 cm tall, around a 30 x 26 cm inside (x 16 to 46, y -13 to +13). A fixed mint-green mattress board, 1 cm thick, fills the inside as its floor. The real setup uses a fitted sheet. The baby doll is a skin-coloured rigid block, 12 x 6 x 5 cm and 400 g, lying on the mattress along x and centred at x 31, y 0. The real setup uses a soft vinyl doll. Three soft items lie on the mattress. A white pillow, 5 x 7 x 3 cm (x by y by height) and 30 g, is at x 23, y +7.5. A brown stuffed bear, 5 x 5 x 5 cm and 50 g, is at x 39, y +7.5. A pink folded blanket, 6 x 7 x 2 cm and 50 g, is at x 31, y -7.5. The table around the crib is clear.
scoring: An item counts as out when its centre is outside the crib's outer walls and it rests still on the table. The baby counts as in place when the doll's centre is inside the crib, it lies flat (tilted under 20 degrees) on the mattress, and no soft item rests on top of it. The score is 0 if the baby is not in place, for example lifted out, tipped, or covered by an item. Otherwise each soft item that is out (pillow, bear, blanket) earns one third. An item still in the crib, on a wall, or held earns nothing. The possible scores are 0, 0.33, 0.67 and 1.0. In a real trial, a photo from above at the end shows what is inside the crib and that the doll lies uncovered.
reset_notes: Lay the doll back in the middle of the mattress along the crib's length. Put the pillow and bear back on the robot's left of it and the blanket on its right, as listed in the setup.
fidelity: The doll, pillow, bear and blanket are rigid blocks, while the real ones are soft. The crib has solid walls in place of slats. The simulation uses rigid-body physics only.
